say.en: A chip factory would rather make billions of one gate than millions of seven. NAND alone or NOR alone can build every other gate. In this lesson: Show that NAND and NOR are universal.

body.en: NAND gives (A·B)'. Tie both inputs together and NAND becomes NOT: (A·A)' = A'. A NAND followed by a NAND-NOT is AND: ((A·B)')' = A·B. NANDing the complements gives OR: (A'·B')' = A + B by De Morgan. Since NOT, AND and OR can express any Boolean function, NAND alone can build any circuit. A two-level AND-OR (SOP) circuit becomes a NAND-NAND circuit by simply replacing every gate with a NAND.

say.en: NAND gives A B'. Tie both inputs together and NAND becomes NOT: A A' = A'. A NAND followed by a NAND-NOT is AND: (A B')' = A B. NANDing the complements gives OR: (A' B')' = A plus B by De Morgan. Since NOT, AND and OR can express any Boolean function, NAND alone can build any circuit. A two-level AND-OR SOP circuit becomes a NAND-NAND circuit by simply replacing every gate with a NAND.
AND: NAND then NOT 2 gates.
OR: (A' B')' 3 gates.
SOP AND-OR gives NAND-NAND.

title.en: On the board: NOR as a universal gate

say.en: NOR gives (A + B)'. Tie the inputs: NOT.
NOR then NOT gives OR.
NOR of the complements gives AND, by De Morgan.
POS circuits map to NOR-NOR just as SOP maps to NAND-NAND.

body.en: *Universal gates* simplify manufacture: a single kind of transistor cell is repeated, so chips are cheaper and more reliable. NAND gates are also among the fastest and smallest in common CMOS technology. When designing, write the simplified SOP, draw the AND-OR circuit and convert it to NAND-NAND; or write the simplified POS and convert the OR-AND circuit to NOR-NOR. A single-variable input to the output gate needs an extra NAND acting as NOT.

problem.en: Implement F = AB + CD using only NAND gates.

steps.en: The SOP form is two AND gates feeding an OR gate.
Replace each gate by a NAND: X = (AB)', Y = (CD)', F = (X·Y)'.
Check: (X·Y)' = X' + Y' = AB + CD by De Morgan.
Three NAND gates in two levels.

narration.en: Implement F = AB + CD using only NAND gates.

say.en: Implement F equals AB plus CD using only NAND gates.
The SOP form is two AND gates feeding an OR gate.
Replace each gate by a NAND: X equals AB', Y equals CD', F equals X Y'.
Check: X Y' = X' plus Y' = AB plus CD by De Morgan.
Three NAND gates in two levels.
So the answer is F equals (AB' CD')' with three NAND gates.

body.en: A bubble at the output of one gate and a bubble at the input of the next cancel out. That is why AND-OR turns into NAND-NAND without changing the function.
